approval: checkpoint H1 approved by Linh on 2026-10-15 with every recommendation of the T8 draft
method: OEH final method = oeh_v2_spec.json via scripts/analysis/oeh_pipeline.py (unchanged since the four-panel test)

oeh_spec.distance: mean distance to the 10 nearest meta-training primary rows in standardized B2 statistics, per MDP-behavior group
oeh_spec.m2: stopped at step 0 (prior_diagnosis/): the continuation rule was not met

rule: external score of the re-selected v2 lower than without M3
SPIBB (rel IBS + rel LL)/2 lower than without M3
internal rel IBS and rel LL vs OEH current each <= +0.02

mdpp.source: MDP Playground 1.0.0 (Rajan et al., 2021), RLToyEnv discrete: sequence_length 1, delay 0, maximally_connected, reward_noise 0, reward_scale 1
mdpp.parameters: A in {2,3,4,5,6,8}; diameter d uniform on the integers with 8 <= d*A <= 64 and d*A*A <= 256; transition_noise ~ U(0, 0.3); reward_density ~ U(0.1, 0.5); terminal_state_density in {0, 0.25}

labmaze.source: labmaze 1.0.6 RandomMaze (DeepMind Lab text-maze generator), simplify=False, one spawn and one object per room; four-way moves
labmaze.parameters: height, width in {9, 11}; max_rooms in {1, 2, 3}; room_min_size 3; room_max_size in {3, 4}; extra_connection_probability ~ U(0, 0.2); success ~ U(0.7, 0.95)

kernel_source: isolated venv (scripts/panel6/export_kernels.py); the project environment keeps Gymnasium 1.0.0
conversion: episodic to continuing: terminal states restart from the initial distribution; reward kept on entry; rewards in [0, 1]
selection: first `mdps` candidates in list order with |S||A| <= 256 that pass the project's dynamic-range filter, whose exact fingerprint is not in run_oeh_final_120.seen_kernels and whose relabelling-invariant signature matches no earlier external kernel and no earlier candidate (scripts/analysis/panel6_families.py)

data.primary_label: first six budgets (sustained 8/10 seeds at NR >= 0.95), seven classes (unchanged)

questions.Q1: Does OEH forecast better than the strongest pilot-extrapolation baseline (B2 + prefix/FQE, task card T2) on the budgets the x10 pilot cannot reach (extrapolation endpoint, task card T1)?
questions.Q3: Does the OEH forecast lead to lower decision regret (tau = 0.8, lambda = 100) than either comparator?

endpoints.ibs_ge: integrated Brier over the thresholds x10, x20, x50 (scripts/analysis/extrapolation_endpoint.py)
endpoints.ll_ext: log loss of the coarsened law {<= x10, x20, x50, > x50}, floor 1e-12

gates.order: fixed sequence F1 -> F2; F2 is tested only if F1 is GO
gates.unit: MDP (pooled over both families, equal weight); per-MDP mean over the 5 behaviors x 3 learners

bootstrap.rule: max-t with the original standard error (one-sided)

F3.report: mean effect and simultaneous one-sided 95% lower bounds; no GO/NO-GO verdict (H1: underpowered as a gate)

not_tested: OEH vs B2 + diagnostics (robust head): the panel-5 contrast is not re-tested; reported only descriptively
full-endpoint IBS and LL: reported descriptively for every method

sample_size.rule: smallest total in [48, 72, 96, 120, 144, 192] with power >= 0.9 for gate family F1 when the opened-panel mean effects are scaled by 0.75, under the worst leave-one-external-panel-out proxy; at least 36 MDPs per family

methods.s4: T4 candidate S4 (B2 + P + D, one head, gated); descriptive only

also: label variant tau = 0.99 (task card T6), descriptive

conditional_methods.tabpfn: TabPFN v2 on B2 (task card T3): predictions are added and sealed separately before the label step (checkpoint H3) if the licence token is available; otherwise reported as not run

dropped.lc_pfn: not used: needs Python < 3.12 and torch <= 1.11, and fits a curve to only four pilot prefixes (H1 decision)

dryrun.rule: stop before freeze if the most frequent class holds more than 80% of a family's labels (fixed before the run)

seed_check.change_from_draft: data seed bases moved from 30M/31M to 70M/72M: 30M+ holds the training-stream seeds of earlier panels (instance seed + 20,000,000); the draft required this check

disclosures: Feasibility only: development candidates drawn with numpy seed 1 (never the panel seeds) were exported, converted and passed through the size cap and the dynamic-range filter (artifacts/week8/panel6_feasibility_2026-10-15); no learner was run on any MDP Playground or labmaze MDP.
The extrapolation endpoint (T1) and the prefix + FQE baseline (T2) were defined and run post hoc on opened panels; panel 6 registers them prospectively.
The sample size uses per-MDP effects of opened panels (artifacts/week8/panel6_power_2026-10-15).
Seed ranges are checked against every earlier dataset manifest at freeze.

Dry run (approved at H1): learners were run on 12 development MDPs per family drawn with numpy seed 1 to check the label distribution; no forecast was scored on them (artifacts/week8/panel6_dryrun_2026-10-15).
